caption: The drawing depicts a single, flared, metallic-looking vessel, likely a vase or cup, placed centrally on a light background. The vessel is drawn in grayscale with meticulous shading to highlight its three-dimensional form and reflective surface. It widens smoothly from a narrower base to a broad, rounded rim. Near the top, just below the rim, there is a decorative horizontal band featuring an ornate symmetrical floral and scrollwork pattern that extends slightly downward at one point. The vessel stands on a double-tiered, circular base. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing showing the same vessel in profile, without decorative details. The primary drawing is enclosed within a faint square border, and the smaller drawing is inside its own smaller square. The artist's signature appears beneath the main drawing, slightly to the right. The background is unadorned and cream-colored, and there are some small discolorations, particularly in the upper right corner.
title: Beaker
